title: Miao Moon Silver: A Journey into Guizhou's Intangible Heritage
summary: The 'Miao Moon Silver' team of six students traveled to Guiyang and Miao villages in Guizhou to explore the unique aesthetics of Miao wax dyeing, silver ornaments, and embroidery. Through interviews with a master artisan and hands-on observation, they uncovered the deep cultural meanings behind traditional craftsmanship and the power of passion in preserving heritage.

title: Growing on the Cliff: The Chongqing Stilt House Journey
summary: A group of fifth-grade students in Chongqing investigated why stilt houses can stand on such steep cliffs. Through fieldwork, interviews, and model building, they discovered that these structures are not built but 'grown' by adapting to the slope and water levels. Their journey transformed them into young urban planners who understand the harmony between architecture and nature.

title: Sketching History: The Six Bricks of Nanjing
summary: Six third-grade students traveled to Nanjing to investigate the unique features of Republic-era buildings. Through sketching intricate details like carved windows and domed gates, they learned about architectural history while developing essential teamwork skills like the 'Double Bookkeeping Method'. Their journey culminated in a collaborative picture book that captured both the city's heritage and their own growth.

title: The House That Grew on the Cliff: Decoding Hongya Cave
summary: Six fifth-grade students investigated how Hongya Cave’s stilt houses stand on a vertical cliff face. Through field observation, historical research at the Three Gorges Museum, and physical modeling, they discovered that the building is not just constructed but 'grown' from the mountain using diagonal bracing and flood-adaptive design.

summary: Our school in Guiyang Guizhou started a maker club in 2023. Twelve students built a small weather station with sensors and uploaded data every day. In 2024 they won the provincial science fair and two teams traveled to Shanghai for the national finals. Over 200 students joined the club in two years.

title: "The sea really is as salty as the textbook said"
summary: Fifth graders from Shunchang County Experimental Primary School, Fujian, reached Qingdao in 2025 and saw the ocean for the first time in their lives. They opened their arms on the beach and shouted at the waves.

title: In seven days, the stars fell into their eyes
summary: In July 2025, the Astronomy Club of Jilin Adream School flew to Beijing: pondering fossils at the Natural History Museum, holding their breath at Tsinghua's telescopes, and giving hand-made moon lamps back to their funders.

title: "What's beyond the mountains?" — now I know
summary: Kids from Tianzhu, Wuwei, Gansu, kept asking what lies beyond the snowy grasslands. In 2025's "Heroes' Journey", they left the Hexi Corridor for eastern cities with their hometown stories in their backpacks.

title: When the caravan came, our school felt like New Year
summary: Along the 2023 Central Plains Tour in Henan, children waited at the school gate for the 27-ton "mobile Dream Center". One boy said the day the caravan arrived felt like New Year.
